scenario: Your client report is due Friday. The sales data arrived three days late. You need until Tuesday to finish.
task: Write to your manager to ask for more time.

parts.label: Why you need more time
parts.missed: Say what held you up: the sales data arrived three days late.
parts.evidence: the sales data for the client report arrived three days late

parts.label: The day you'll finish
parts.missed: Name the day. "More time" doesn't tell Sam how long.
parts.evidence: I need until Tuesday to finish it

parts.label: A question asking whether that day works for Sam
parts.missed: End with a question, so Sam can agree or offer another day.

parts.label: No blame for the delay
parts.missed: Say what arrived late and when. Leave out who was responsible.

model: Hi Sam, the sales data for the client report arrived three days late, so I need until Tuesday to finish it. Would Tuesday work for you?
